Atwood & Palmer Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 2.12% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 117,234 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $18.07M, down from 119,778 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Atwood & Palmer Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $897.80 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.09% or $1.91 during the last trading session, reaching $176.94. About 21.82 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% since March 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500.
